ca-sb9.bill: California Housing Opportunity and More Efficiency (HOME) Act
ca-sb9.leverage_point: Residents can advocate for local compliance and use SB 9 to support duplexes or lot splits at public hearings, countering exclusionary zoning arguments.
ca-sb9.summary: SB 9 allows homeowners to split single-family residential lots and build up to two units per lot, effectively enabling up to four homes on parcels previously zoned for one.

ca-ab2011.bill: Affordable Housing and High Road Jobs Act of 2022
ca-ab2011.leverage_point: Residents can support projects using AB 2011 to advocate for affordable housing on commercial sites and ensure local governments follow streamlined approval requirements.
ca-ab2011.summary: AB 2011 streamlines approval for affordable and mixed-income housing on underutilized commercial corridors, bypassing discretionary review if labor and affordability standards are met.

ca-sb35.bill: Streamlined Ministerial Approval Process for Infill Housing
ca-sb35.leverage_point: Residents can invoke SB 35 to demand streamlined approval for eligible projects and challenge local delays or denials at public meetings.
ca-sb35.summary: SB 35 requires local governments to use a streamlined, ministerial approval process for qualifying infill housing developments in cities not meeting state housing goals.

ca-sb330.leverage_point: Residents can cite SB 330 to oppose local downzoning or procedural delays and support housing projects at city council or planning commission meetings.
ca-sb330.summary: SB 330 limits local governments' ability to downzone, impose housing moratoria, or increase procedural barriers to housing production during the declared housing crisis.

ca-ab1287.leverage_point: Residents can use AB 1287 to advocate for higher-density affordable projects and ensure local governments grant the expanded bonuses as required.
ca-ab1287.summary: AB 1287 expands California’s Density Bonus Law, allowing additional density bonuses for projects that provide more affordable housing than required, including a new 'stacked bonus' for deeper affordability.

ca-sb1123.leverage_point: Residents can reference SB 1123 to support subdivision of vacant lots and challenge unnecessary local restrictions at planning meetings.
ca-sb1123.summary: SB 1123 streamlines the subdivision of vacant lots for small-scale residential development, reducing procedural barriers and enabling faster housing production on underutilized land.
